items.en: Ukrainian intelligence: Russia to test new ballistic missile with ~800 km range, possibly by striking western Ukraine
items.nl: Oekraïense inlichtingendienst: Rusland wil nieuwe ballistische raket met bereik tot ~800 km testen, mogelijk op doelen in West-Oekraïne
items.sEn: Ukraine's military intelligence directorate (HUR) says Russia is preparing final tests of a new ballistic missile with a range of up to roughly 800 kilometers before the end of 2026.
